api/src/services/events/__init__.py.name: Announcing events
api/src/services/events/__init__.py.description: Provides the shared way to announce that something happened so interested automations can react.

api/src/services/events/builtins.py.name: Built-in announcements
api/src/services/events/builtins.py.description: Announces the standard platform happenings, such as a workflow finishing, failing, or a new version appearing.

api/src/services/events/processor.py.name: Incoming events
api/src/services/events/processor.py.description: Takes messages arriving from outside systems, checks them and starts the automations waiting for them.

api/src/services/events/registry.py.name: Event topics
api/src/services/events/registry.py.description: Lists the approved event topics with an example of each message so builders know what they can react to.

api/src/services/events/validation.py.name: Event topic check
api/src/services/events/validation.py.description: Rejects event topics that are not on the approved list.

api/src/services/git_repo_manager.py.name: Workspace working copy
api/src/services/git_repo_manager.py.description: Keeps a working copy of the workspace in step with cloud file storage so version history has a home.

api/src/services/github_api.py.name: GitHub file operations
api/src/services/github_api.py.description: Reads and writes files, branches and saves to GitHub on the workspace's behalf.

api/src/services/github_config.py.name: GitHub settings
api/src/services/github_config.py.description: Stores the GitHub connection details and sign-in pass, encrypted, for the workspace repository.

api/src/services/github_sync_entity_meta.name: Sync item labels
api/src/services/github_sync_entity_meta.description: Reads a file being synced to work out what kind of thing it is so the review screen can label it.

api/src/services/github_sync.py.name: Workspace sync
api/src/services/github_sync.py.description: Copies workflows, apps, forms and settings between the workspace and GitHub, flagging clashes for review.

api/src/services/manifest_generator.py.name: Workspace description files
api/src/services/manifest_generator.py.description: Turns the live workspace into portable description files that can be stored in version history or shared.

api/src/services/manifest_import.py.name: Import workspace contents
api/src/services/manifest_import.py.description: Recreates workflows, forms, apps, tables and roles from description files, leaving anything unlisted untouched.

api/src/services/oauth_config_service.py.name: Sign-in providers
api/src/services/oauth_config_service.py.description: Stores the outside sign-in providers staff can use and which one is preferred.

api/src/services/oauth_entity_id.py.name: Provider account identity
api/src/services/oauth_entity_id.py.description: Reads the account identifier a sign-in provider returns so each connection is tied to the right company.

api/src/services/oauth_provider.py.name: Access pass handling
api/src/services/oauth_provider.py.description: Gets and renews the access passes that let the platform call outside services on a customer's behalf.

api/src/services/oauth_sso.py.name: Staff single sign-in
api/src/services/oauth_sso.py.description: Signs staff in through their company identity provider and reads their name, email and groups.

api/src/services/oauth_state_core.py.name: Sign-in safety check
api/src/services/oauth_state_core.py.description: Protects the sign-in round trip with a one-time code so a faked reply cannot take over an account.

api/src/services/oauth_state.py.name: Connection safety check
api/src/services/oauth_state.py.description: Protects each connection round trip with a one-time code so an old reply cannot be replayed.

api/src/services/oauth_storage.py.name: Connection storage
api/src/services/oauth_storage.py.description: Saves each connected account's access passes encrypted and keeps them up to date.

api/src/services/service_lifecycle.py.name: Always-on services
api/src/services/service_lifecycle.py.description: Keeps services that run on a timetable in step with their workflow, hands out the work and stops them safely.

api/src/services/sync_lock.py.name: One sync at a time
api/src/services/sync_lock.py.description: Stops two syncs running at once so the workspace and GitHub never overwrite each other.

api/src/services/sync_ops.py.name: Sync changes
api/src/services/sync_ops.py.description: Describes each change a sync makes, such as add, update, replace roles or retire, so it can be reviewed.

api/src/services/webhooks/__init__.py.name: Incoming messages
api/src/services/webhooks/__init__.py.description: Groups the code that receives messages from outside services and turns them into events.

api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/__ini.name: Message translators
api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/__ini.description: Groups the translators that understand each outside service's own message format.

api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/gener.name: Simple web messages
api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/gener.description: Receives messages from any service that can send to a web address you paste in.

api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/local.name: Test message source
api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/local.description: Pretends to be an outside service during development so subscription renewal can be tried safely.

api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/micro.name: Teams messages
api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/micro.description: Checks and tidies messages from Microsoft Teams so chats and mentions can start automations.

api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/micro.name: Microsoft 365 messages
api/src/services/webhooks/adapters/micro.description: Receives Microsoft 365 change notices for mail, calendar and files, and keeps those subscriptions alive.

api/src/services/webhooks/auth.py.name: Message credentials
api/src/services/webhooks/auth.py.description: Finds the right connection and access pass for a message arriving from a specific customer.

api/src/services/webhooks/lifecycle.py.name: Subscription upkeep
api/src/services/webhooks/lifecycle.py.description: Sets up, refreshes and removes the subscriptions outside services need to keep sending messages.

api/src/services/webhooks/protocol.py.name: Message handling rules
api/src/services/webhooks/protocol.py.description: Sets the shared rules every message translator follows: check it, deliver it or reject it.

api/src/services/webhooks/registry.py.name: Message translator list
api/src/services/webhooks/registry.py.description: Keeps the list of available translators so the right one is picked for each incoming source.

api/src/services/webhooks/signing_secret.name: Message signing secret
api/src/services/webhooks/signing_secret.description: Stores the secret that proves a message really came from the expected service, and keeps it hidden.
